title: Index of a coefficient-estimation sample
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. For a frequency $S$ in the low-degree junta Fourier family and a coefficient-estimation sample index $i$, assign the index $	ext{rank}(S)m+i$ in the combined restricted sample space, where $m$ is the coefficient-estimation sample count.
hypotheses_covered: Finite set $P$ of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$
$S$ belongs to the low-degree junta Fourier family
$i$ is a valid coefficient-estimation sample index
